focused_tests.qualification: All final selected targets were built through normal Cargo. The complete TiKV unit-test binary was built with a RUSTC_WRAPPER preserving Cargo arguments and appending CGU16/serial LLVM for the large lib-test target; 11 selected MVCC reuse tests ran and the remaining tests were filtered. Region also used serial LLVM/CGU16. This is targeted verification, not a full-suite pass.

limitations: No full make dev or full-suite pass
Partially optimized Rust test profile with assertions/overflow checks
Repeated cache-warmed local CPU scans; no release/cold-I/O/production-throughput conclusion
interpretation.percentage_change: 100 * (reuse / fresh - 1); negative means lower CPU time
interpretation.uncertainty: Keep independent per-round estimates and samples. A min/max across two paired changes is not a pooled confidence interval.
